source_agreement_groups.text: If uplink Tx switching is triggered, the length of the additional time for PUSCH preparation procedure equals to the length of UL switching period.

For SUL, if uplink Tx switching is configured, the state of Tx chains of last UL transmission is assumed in case of no UL transmission.
Work assumption: For inter-band UL CA, if uplink Tx switching is configured, the state of Tx chains of last UL transmission is assumed in case of no UL transmission. It can be revisited in RAN1#100bis.

For standalone SUL, if UL switching period is configured by RRC
The switching period is not always applicable on the carrier configured with switching period.
The switching period is only applicable when the scheduled UL transmissions are switched between 1Tx carrier 1 and 2Tx carrier 2. 
For each UL transmission occasion on a carrier, the existence of the switching period is determined one time every occasion.
Note: 2Tx carrier 2 refers to an UL carrier capable of 2 Tx chains and both 1-port and 2-port UL transmissions.

For inter-band UL CA, if uplink Tx switching is configured, UE is not expected to be scheduled or configured with UL transmissions that result in simultaneous 1Tx transmission on carrier 1 and 2Tx transmission on carrier 2.

Case 11 Tx on carrier 1 and 1 Tx on carrier 2Case 20 Tx on carrier 1 and 2 Tx on carrier 2
For inter-band UL CA, if UL switching period is configured by RRC
The switching period is not always applicable on the carrier configured with switching period.
The switching period is at least applicable between 1-port transmission in carrier 1 and 2-port transmission in carrier 2.

For inter-band UL CA, UE is not expected to [be scheduled or configured to] transmit on any of the two carriers in the switching period.
FFS: Whether to handle the case when switching period cannot be ensured by gNB.

Decision: As per email decision posted on Mar. 2nd,
Agreement:
If uplink Tx switching is triggered, the length of the additional time for PUSCH preparation procedure equals to the length of UL switching period.
Agreements:

Clarify the following agreements with changes in red
Agreements:
For standalone SUL, if UL switching period is configured by RRC
The switching period is not always applicable on the carrier configured with switching period.
The switching period is only applicable when the scheduled UL transmissions are switched between 1Tx carrier 1 and 2Tx carrier 2.
For each UL transmission occasion on a carrier, the existence of the switching period is determined one time every occasion.
Note: 2Tx carrier 2 refers to an UL carrier capable of 2 Tx chains and both 1-port and 2-port UL transmissions.
[100e-5.1LS-TxSwitching-03] – Jianchi (China Telecom)
Email discussion/approvalon remaining issues on inter-band UL CA, including:

The related issue and solutions w.r.t. the condition of the presence of the switching period, including mapping between UL transmission ports and Tx chain, switching mechanism, UL phase, support of codebook/non-codebook based PUSCH transmission, etc.
Clarification on handling of transmission collision between 1Tx transmission on carrier 1 and 2Tx transmission on carrier 2 for configured transmission.
and conclude by 2/28; if there is a spec impact, followed by endorsing the corresponding TP by 3/3
R1-2001275[100e-5.1LS-TxSwitching-03] Email discussion/approval on remaining issues on inter-band UL CAChina Telecom
Decision: As per email decision posted on Mar. 3rd,
Agreement:

For inter-band UL CA, if uplink Tx switching is configured, UE is not expected to be scheduled or configured with UL transmissions that result in simultaneous 1Tx transmission on carrier 1 and 2Tx transmission on carrier 2.
Working assumption:
For inter-band UL CA, if option 2 is supported, the following sub-option 2-3 is defined.
Minimize RAN1 impact
No new RAN4 impact
No new TDM pattern
It can be revisited in future RAN1 meeting with taking into consideration any relevant RAN4 decisions on DL interruption for UL Tx switching.
Option 2-3

Case 11 Tx on carrier 1 and 1 Tx on carrier 2Case 20 Tx on carrier 1 and 2 Tx on carrier 2
For inter-band UL CA, if UL switching period is configured by RRC
The switching period is not always applicable on the carrier configured with switching period.
The switching period is at least applicable between 1-port transmission in carrier 1 and 2-port transmission in carrier 2.
Agreements:
For inter-band UL CA, UE is not expected to [be scheduled or configured to] transmit on any of the two carriers in the switching period.
FFS: Whether to handle the case when switching period cannot be ensured by gNB.
[100e-5.1LS-TxSwitching-04] – Jianchi (China Telecom)
Email discussion/approvalon remaining issues on inter-band EN-DC without SUL, including
The related issue and solutions w.r.t. the condition of the presence of the switching period, including mapping between UL transmission ports and Tx chain, TDM pattern, switching mechanism, etc.
Handling of transmission collision between 1Tx transmission in LTE and 2Tx transmission in NR.
and conclude by 2/28; if there is a spec impact, followed by endorsing the correspoiding TP by 3/3

133:     ### CQ 결과 규칙
134:     
135:     ### 정렬 기준 (Default Sort Order)
136:     
137:     | CQ 그룹 | Primary Sort | Secondary Sort | 구현 속성 |
138:     | --- | --- | --- | --- |
139:     | CQ1. Resolution 조회 | Meeting 번호 DESC (최신 먼저) | Agenda 번호 ASC, Sequence ASC | `meetingNumberInt DESC` |
140:     | CQ2. Tdoc ↔ Resolution | Meeting 번호 DESC | Sequence ASC | `meetingNumberInt DESC` |
141:     | CQ3. 회사별 기여도 | Count DESC (많은 순) | Company 이름 ASC | `count DESC` |
142:     | CQ4. 역할 조회 | Meeting 번호 DESC | Agenda 번호 ASC | `meetingNumberInt DESC` |
143:     | CQ6. 트렌드/비교 | Meeting 번호 ASC (시계열) | - | `meetingNumberInt ASC` |
144:     
145:     *참고: "Meeting 번호" 정렬은 Phase-1 Meeting 클래스의 `meetingNumberInt` 속성 사용 (숫자 기반 정렬 보장)*

148:     
149:     | CQ 유형 | 기본값 | 적용 CQ |
150:     | --- | --- | --- |

153:     | 트렌드 조회 | 전체 | CQ6 |

159:     ## 3. Scope 정의
160:     
161:     ### 3.1 포함 (In Scope)
162:     
163:     | 구분 | 포함 대상 | 비고 |
164:     | --- | --- | --- |
165:     | **Resolution** | Agreement, Conclusion, Working Assumption | CQ1~3, CQ6 |
166:     | **Role** | Moderator, Ad-hoc Chair | CQ4 |
167:     | **Embedded Content** | Figure, Table, Chart, Equation | CQ 대상 아님, Resolution 완결성 위해 포함 |
168:     | **데이터 소스** | Final Report 본문 | Annex 제외 |
169:     
170:     ### 3.2 제외 (Out of Scope)
171:     
172:     | 제외 대상 | 이유 |
173:     | --- | --- |
174:     | 본문의 `**Decision:**` 패턴 | Resolution과 용어 혼동 방지 |
175:     | Annex (B, C, D, E, F) | 본문만 파싱 원칙 |
176:     | Resolution 의미/내용 검색 | Vector DB 영역 (향후 확장) |
177:     | CQ5 (후속 조치) | Annex 의존 |
178:     | RAN1 Chair | 고정 역할 |
179:     | Figure 이미지 콘텐츠 | 별도 저장소에서 관리, Graph DB는 메타데이터만 |
180:     | Table 셀 데이터 | 별도 저장소에서 관리, Graph DB는 메타데이터와 수식만 |

655:     ### 4.3 Embedded Content 클래스
656:     
657:     | 클래스 | 정의 | Graph DB 저장 | 별도 저장소 |
658:     | --- | --- | --- | --- |
659:     | **Figure** | 문서 내 삽입된 이미지 | ID, caption, filePath | 원본 이미지 파일 |

664:     
665:     - Figure, Table, Chart 모두 여러 인스턴스를 가지며 Resolution과 참조 관계를 가짐
666:     - 기술적 Figure/Table/Chart 대상 (포맷팅용 제외). 캡션 유무와 무관하게 Resolution 본문에 포함된 실질적 콘텐츠를 추출하며, 식별 기준은 Step 7에서 정의.

968:     ## 8. content vs contentWithEquations 사용 규칙
969:     
970:     Resolution 검색 및 답변 생성 시 두 필드의 역할이 다름.
971:     
972:     ### 8.1 필드별 용도
973:     
974:     | Phase | 사용 필드 | 이유 |
975:     | --- | --- | --- |
976:     | **검색 (Text-to-Cypher)** | content | `[EQUATION]` 마커로 노이즈 제거, 텍스트 매칭 정확도 향상 |
977:     | **답변 생성 (LLM context)** | contentWithEquations | 수식 포함 완전한 정보로 정확한 답변 |
978:     | **UI 렌더링** | contentWithEquations | LaTeX 수식 렌더링 |
979:     
980:     ### 8.2 처리 흐름
981:     
982:     ```
983:     1. 사용자 질문 → Text-to-Cypher 생성
984:     2. Cypher 쿼리에서 content 필드로 Resolution 검색
985:     3. 검색된 Resolution의 contentWithEquations를 LLM context로 전달
986:     4. LLM이 contentWithEquations 기반으로 답변 생성
987:     5. UI에서 contentWithEquations의 LaTeX 렌더링
988:     
989:     ```
990:     
991:     ### 8.3 예시
992:     
993:     **검색 Cypher**:
994:     
995:     ```
996:     MATCH (r:Agreement)
997:     WHERE r.content CONTAINS 'processing time'
998:     RETURN r.resolutionId, r.contentWithEquations
999:     LIMIT 5
1000:     
1001:     ```
1002:     
1003:     *Note: WHERE 조건은 `content`, RETURN은 `contentWithEquations`*
